info.name: 101516420 - COMP3123 Assignment 1 - Employee Management API (Rabin Kunnananickal Binu)
info.description:
Postman collection for COMP3123 Assignment 1.

HOW TO USE
1. Start the API (npm run dev) - or set the collection variable baseUrl to your Vercel URL.
2. Start from an empty database (otherwise the two signup requests return 409).
3. Run the folders in order (or use Run collection). Tokens and employee ids are saved automatically.
4. For "Expired JWT", run `npm run token:expired -- <userIdA>` and paste the output into the collection variable expiredToken.
5. Folder 10 (rate limiting) is intentionally last: after it, logins/signups from your IP are blocked for 15 minutes
   (restart the local server to reset the in-memory counters).

Test users: alice_test / alice@example.com and bob_test / bob@example.com, both with password Password@123.
